thesis: Pre-revenue, R&D-stage company pioneering sulfide-based solid-state battery technology for EVs. Asset-light model: sells proprietary sulfide solid electrolyte and licenses cell designs to OEMs (BMW, Ford, SK On) rather than building gigafactories. A January 2026 raise lifted liquidity to ~$435M, giving ample multi-year runway against FY2026 cash-investment guidance of $85–100M. Commercial revenue still expected ~2027–2028 — a binary outcome of breakthrough adoption versus cash-burn failure, with the stock trading near its 52-week low.

financials.revenue_source: Government grants, joint development agreements, electrolyte samples

business_model.electrolyte_sales: Sell proprietary sulfide solid electrolyte to cell manufacturers
business_model.technology_licensing: License battery cell designs and manufacturing processes to OEMs

drivers: Successful pilot line production and OEM qualification
First major licensing or electrolyte-supply deal announcement
Solid-state batteries become an EV industry standard
SK On, BMW, and Ford milestones convert into volume programs
Valuation multiple expansion as commercialization nears

risks: Manufacturing challenges prove insurmountable at scale
QuantumScape or Toyota reach market first
Traditional lithium-ion improves faster than expected
Cash burn accelerates; further dilutive raises needed
Loss of a key BMW, Ford, or SK On partnership

base_case.assumptions: Electrolyte sales and first licensing revenue begin ~2027–2028; 1–2 OEM programs advance to qualification; multi-year runway avoids near-term dilution; the stock re-rates modestly as milestones land but commercialization risk keeps a discount.

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — cash burn, liquidity, and timeline update
Pilot-line and sulfide electrolyte production milestones
BMW / Ford / SK On qualification and deployment updates
Commercialization and first licensing revenue recognition

key_risks: Technology fails to scale from lab to manufacturing
Competitive displacement by QuantumScape, Toyota, or improved lithium-ion
Additional dilutive equity raises despite current runway
Multi-year timeline to commercial revenue and profitability
Concentrated reliance on BMW, Ford, and SK On partnerships
